change: Extracted generation-checked Condvar parking into a small internal operation so notification ordering and fallback can be tested independently of GPU/timeout masking

targeted_cases: Signal before park returns GenerationChanged without waiting
Signal after same-mutex atomic unlock+park awakens waiter
No signal takes explicit timeout fallback
Generation wrap max->0 does not lose notification
Late completion signal after cancelled service retirement starts no worker

limits: Targeted synchronization tests, not exhaustive concurrency model checking
Late post-cancellation notification is injected through production service signal entry point
No physical device loss/hang/OOM, performance, energy or cross-platform qualification
Earlier benchmark performance gates remain inconclusive
